title: Comfort and system use over hour-long drives
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on comfort during hour-long trips and the time needed to get used to the vehicle’s system, with several fragments too vague to classify clearly.

positive.summary: The positive review praises comfort on long regular drives, especially around multi-hour trips.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe lingering discomfort after about an hour and a system that feels complicated or unintuitive even with additional time to learn it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention charging figures, expected performance on regular trips, time spent learning features, or battery change over an hour drive without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: This cluster combines more than one subject, including ride comfort, system learning curve, and energy or battery observations.
Several fragments are too brief or context-limited to determine clear sentiment.
All examples come from the US G60 sample, so no cross-market comparison is available from these fragments.
